            .and_then(|time| time.duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).ok())
            .map(|since| since.as_nanos() as i64)
            .unwrap_or_default();
        Some(format!("{mtime_ns}:{}", metadata.len()))
    })
    .collect::<Vec<_>>().join
